title: Your AI Agent Needs a Face (Open Bot Avatar)

lines.tts: Every AI agent in this town looks exactly the same.
lines.text: Every AI agent in this town looks exactly the same.

lines.tts: Ask the coding bot for help, and the email bot shows up.
lines.text: Ask the coding bot for help, and the email bot shows up.

lines.tts: It's called Open Bot Avatar. Every face is one tiny JSON file: a single shape, plus where the eyes go.
lines.text: It's called Open Bot Avatar. Every face is one tiny Jason file, a single shape, plus where the eyes go.

lines.tts: The renderer does the rest. It adds depth, makes them blink, and their eyes follow you around.
lines.text: The renderer does the rest. It adds depth, makes them blink, and their eyes follow you around.

lines.tts: They even have moods. Thinking, while your agent works... and happy, when it's done.
lines.text: They even have moods. Thinking while your agent works, and happy when it's done.

lines.tts: Twenty-two ready-made faces. Or describe one, and any AI will write it for you.
lines.text: Twenty-two ready-made faces. Or describe one, and any AI will write it for you.

lines.tts: It's free, open source and M.I.T. licensed. Search Open Bot Avatar on GitHub.

lines.tts: Now if only the email bot would stop hitting reply-all.
